architectureObjects.label: Agent Shell Deployment Binding
invariants: ACTIVE and SUPERSEDED are the only canonical binding states and a binding identity is immutable
Product Edge is the unique writer of deployment bindings history heads content-addressed operation manifests immutable request admissions and their outbox
Deployment genesis is an explicit one-time administrative operation and never a service-start or request-path default

At most one ACTIVE binding selects the canonical WINDMILL_PRODUCT_EDGE admission gateway for a deployment and zero ACTIVE is an allowed fail-closed cutover window while multiple ACTIVE bindings admit no mutating Owner request
A client-only or transport-only successor preserves the same effective principal scope capability and audit policies while changing attribution only
The first binding may use genesis only when the authoritative deployment history is empty and its expected history head is EMPTY

SUPERSEDED is the predecessor request-origin fence and a successor may commit ACTIVE only by one durable atomic serialization against the exact history head after its exact predecessor identity is SUPERSEDED the policies match exactly and the deployment has zero current ACTIVE bindings
A successor generation is exactly predecessor generation plus one its cutover epoch is strictly greater and its immutable binding identity is globally unique across deployment history
The committed successor becomes the authoritative deployment history head so stale heads forged genesis reused identities nonmonotonic successors and concurrent losing writers fail closed
The unique ACTIVE binding must be the authoritative deployment history head and ACTIVE may transition only once to SUPERSEDED which is irreversible across restart rollback and replay

Every mutating Agent Shell request durably and atomically serializes its request identity against the authoritative history head after verifying that exact head is the unique ACTIVE binding and before any Owner submission

A history-head advance between admission read and request commit rejects the new request while a previously committed in-flight request continues to resolve by its original request binding and admission-head identities

In-flight requests retain their original request and binding identities and after cutover may perform a still-unreceipted first mutation only against the immediate policy-equivalent ACTIVE successor with exact stored lineage and current original authorization at the final cut while zero ACTIVE blocks it and every new admission requires the current ACTIVE head

An expired predecessor cannot use the ordinary successor path and may recover only through one content-addressed ExpiredManifestRecoveryEpochV1 that binds the exact authorization frontier deployment head and complete retained added and removed manifest transition set

Before either expired-manifest recovery Owner write one content-bound target must match read-only database role and PostgreSQL system-identifier readback from both supplied endpoints with distinct Owner roles in the same authority database

Expired-manifest recovery appends or exact-replays OA2 before Product Edge irreversibly fences B1 and compare-and-swaps B2 while every partial state remains fail closed and no historical fact is rewritten
Missing stale self-asserted or policy-mismatched binding context is rejected before any business Owner mutation

architectureObjects.label: Operator Authorization
invariants: The separately named Operator Authorization Issuer is the unique writer of issuance and the revocation frontier while Product Edge only direct-resolves its canonical facts
Issuer writes and Product Edge admission use distinct PostgreSQL roles in one authority database and conflicting row locks enforce one revocation and admission cut
The Agent Shell cannot self-assert issuer principal audience scope expiry revocation or operation authority
Every mutating request binds one EFFECTIVE authorization whose issuer audience operation scope time evidence and revocation frontier are validated before Owner submission
Missing stale expired revoked wrong-audience cross-principal broadened or unverifiable authorization creates no Owner request
Replay binds the original authorization and manifest identities and cannot extend validity or widen scope

An expired-manifest recovery epoch preserves issuer key principal audience scope request proof scope policy and audit policy while explicitly binding every retained added and removed manifest semantic key and both complete content-addressed sets

Retained manifests only narrow added manifests retain the live-trading real-trading and protected-feedback prohibition floor removal grants nothing and OA2 alone grants no Product Edge request authority

After canonical authorization binding manifest and admission locks are held Product Edge samples one final half-open cut immediately before the first write revalidates every authority there and binds that same cut into admission identity and receipt

architectureObjects.label: Agent Operation Manifest
invariants: Only content-addressed APPROVED operations may form typed Owner requests and shell-local names or prose cannot grant capability
Changed Skill MCP schema effect target or prohibited data rule requires a new manifest identity and authorization binding
Missing stale superseded revoked digest-mismatched or unlisted operations are rejected before Owner submission
Replay resolves the same manifest content and cannot substitute a newer operation meaning

architectureObjects.label: R&D Request
invariants: Ambiguous target operation missing source or malformed typed meaning creates no Owner submission
Product Edge commits one immutable canonical request admission and outbox before R&D receives only its opaque locator for direct resolution
A committed admission retains its original binding authorization frontier manifest and cut across supersession expiry or revocation and is never rewritten

Expiry or revocation before the first downstream custody forbids submission while committed custody may resolve or terminalize but a new provider invocation requires a current one-use invocation admission

A committed provider claim with a lost response resolves as the exact CLAIMED request attempt and claim with RUN_BOUNDED_EXECUTION_AGENT as its sole resumable action starts that claim once and never creates a successor claim or second provider invocation
After INVOCATION_STARTED no rerun is admitted without an authoritative terminal Owner receipt and the safe projection is manual provider reconciliation

Product Edge unavailable storage-unknown or ambiguous authority including possible existing custody returns SUBMITTED_OR_UNKNOWN with RESOLVE_SAME_ATTEMPT_IDENTITY and never REJECTED_NO_WRITE or successor authority
Environment-authorized legacy rows are never backfilled terminal legacy is read-only quarantined identity collisions fail closed and activation stops on legacy nonterminal S2 custody
Transport or shell success never proves an R&D transition and only the correlated R&D-owned receipt is authoritative
SOURCED_HYPOTHESIS carries only the bounded Qualification protected-feedback projection already resolved for the same principal scope and exact R&D basis without exposing protected detail to Research
The caller supplies only an untrusted independence rationale and cannot supply or override either canonical frontier the independence disposition or basis identity
Missing stale malformed cross-principal cross-scope cross-basis or conflicting Owner authority remains SUBMITTED_OR_UNKNOWN and creates no R&D receipt Intent TrialFamily census or outbox write
ATTENDED_D_ONLY_REPAIR binds an explicit user selection to the exact current Governance generation and Artifact cut and Product Edge cannot self-assert any of those Owner facts

A D-only request changes no Research Intent hypothesis parameter universe PIT market semantics cost slippage capacity model or protected-feedback frontier and any such change is rejected into the sourced-hypothesis path

D0_NON_EXECUTABLE creates no new deployable Artifact while D1_EXECUTABLE_REPAIR requires a new immutable Artifact and the requested terminal never grants validation Qualification Governance deployment or trading authority
Missing stale ambiguous or post-result-reclassified feedback ancestry is rejected rather than treated as a fresh research lineage
Admission atomically binds the current authoritative history head which must equal the unique ACTIVE binding before Owner submission
Admission validates the non-self-assertable Operator Authorization and content-addressed Agent Operation Manifest before Owner submission
The same request identity and meaning join the same receipt while changed meaning is rejected

Concurrent or conflicting requests for one generation and evaluation cut resolve by the exact declared total precedence and same-rank canonical request identity tie-break so input order cannot change the admitted operation
Request conflict precedence selects among explicit competing requests only and never substitutes for Governance adverse-evidence action selection
Transport or shell success never proves a lifecycle transition and only the correlated Governance receipt is authoritative
Admission atomically binds the current authoritative history head which must equal the unique ACTIVE binding before Owner submission
